name: Jhaveri Credits & Capital Ltd
about: Incorporated in1993, Jhaveri Credits & Capital  Ltd provides broking platform for dealing in various Commodities in spot and future markets[1]
keyPoints:
Memberships:[1]
Company is a broking member of Commodity Exchange viz. Multi Commodity Exchange Of India Limited and National Spot Exchange Ltd. 
 On 14th March 2023, company's application for surrender of Self-Clearing Membership was approved. Currently, company has decided to consider Financing, Investment & Broking advisory business

pros: Company is expected to give good quarter
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Promoter holding has decreased over last quarter: -2.80%
Company has a low return on equity of 3.26% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.2.42 Cr.
Debtor days have increased from 40.7 to 59.8 days.
Working capital days have increased from 109 days to 227 days
